title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**Competitive Salary, Plus Benefits** 




  





 Charterhouse are partnered with a fast\-growing technology company at the forefront of AI\-optimised hardware and infrastructure. This business is building the infrastructure that powers the next generation of AI. As their team expands, they are looking to hire a Senior AI Engineers to join a highly technical and driven engineering team in Dubai.
 



  





 About the Role
 



 The Senior AI Engineer will take ownership of designing and building scalable AI systems and pipelines centred around LLMs, leveraging Python and modern GenAI frameworks. A key part of the role involves developing internal RAG\-based systems and compelling demo applications that demonstrate the capabilities of the company's proprietary hardware, working at the intersection of cutting\-edge software and advanced silicon. The position also requires close collaboration with highly technical engineering teams to profile and optimise AI workloads across diverse hardware platforms, including custom accelerator architectures.
 



  





 On the technical delivery side, the Senior AI Engineer will be responsible for optimising prompts, embeddings, retrieval strategies, and overall model behaviour for production\-grade performance, as well as fine\-tuning models for domain\-specific use cases using approaches such as LoRA, qLoRA, or full fine\-tuning. The role involves building and maintaining custom pipelines for document ingestion, chunking, embedding generation, and retrieval, while defining robust workflows for model versioning, reproducibility, and experiment tracking.
 



  





 About You
 



 The ideal candidate will bring strong Python programming skills and hands\-on experience with data analysis libraries including Pandas, NumPy, and SQL. A proven track record delivering retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) solutions is essential, alongside experience working with vector databases such as Milvus or Chroma, and evaluation frameworks such as Ragas or DeepEval. Experience deploying and monitoring large\-scale AI systems using tools such as ClearML or Kubeflow is highly advantageous.
 



  





 Exposure to CPU, GPU, or custom accelerator architectures, including NPUs, TPUs, or ASICs, is strongly preferred and will be a differentiating factor for this client.

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
description:
In this role, you’ll join a newly formed forward\-deployed engineering group that partners with high\-priority enterprise clients to take AI from idea to production. This is a delivery\-first role for engineers who enjoy being close to real users. You’ll uncover high\-value use cases, prototype quickly and ship robust solutions that create measurable outcomes.
 



  





 Think of it as a blend of product engineer, solutions architect and hands\-on applied AI builder—working in small squads, owning end\-to\-end execution and operating comfortably in ambiguous environments.
 



  





  





**What you’ll do** 




  




* Work directly with senior client stakeholders to understand objectives, constraints and success metrics
* Run discovery sessions (workshops, whiteboarding, rapid scoping) to identify practical AI opportunities
* Design and build PoCs and production\-ready applications using LLMs, multimodal models, and agentic workflows
* Engineer end\-to\-end systems: data ingestion, orchestration, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, security and performance tuning
* Deploy to customer environments (cloud or on\-prem), ensuring scalability, compliance and operational readiness
* Iterate fast: test hypotheses, measure impact, refine prompts/policies/tools and harden prototypes into durable services
* Build reusable templates, accelerators, and internal tooling to speed up delivery across industries
* Collaborate closely with commercial and delivery partners (solutions, product, research, customer success) to execute well
* Capture learnings, document patterns, and help mentor other engineers as the team grows



  










**What we’re looking for** 




  




* 5\+ years in software engineering, applied ML, or AI product delivery
* Strong coding ability in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript (clean APIs, production\-grade practices)
* Practical experience with modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch or TensorFlow) and deploying models into real systems
* Hands\-on familiarity with LLM\-powered applications: RAG, tool/function calling, workflow orchestration, evaluation, guardrails, or multi\-agent patterns
* Experience deploying to AWS/Azure/GCP and/or working with enterprise/on\-prem setups (networking, IAM, security considerations)
* Ability to translate vague business problems into well\-scoped builds, with clear trade\-offs and measurable results
* Confident communicator who can explain complex concepts to technical and non\-technical audiences and build trust quickly
* Comfortable working across domains (e.g., healthcare, finance, retail, public sector) and adapting to different constraints
* Willingness to travel or spend time on\-site with customers when needed



  





  





**Nice to have** 




  




* Prior client\-facing delivery experience (implementation, solutions engineering, consulting, or forward\-deployed work)
* Exposure to NLP, computer vision, reinforcement learning, or multi\-agent research methods
* Experience building internal platforms, deployment templates, or reusable delivery frameworks



  










**Why this role** 




  





 You’ll work on high\-stakes, real\-world implementations where customers matter. If you enjoy rapid experimentation, building reliable systems, and partnering directly with customers to turn cutting\-edge AI into outcomes, this role will suit you.
 



  





  





**Recruitment process** 




  





 The role has recently opened so please apply. When your application is reviewed, you will be contacted if your profile meets the requirements. The customer will conduct both online and face\-to\-face interviews based on location and availability.
 



  





  





**Your consultant**

 At ZDF Sparks, we focus on making AI tangible, turning complex ideas into reliable, scalable tools for the media industry. We are looking for a
 **Senior AI Engineer (m/f/d)** 
 in Full\-time (40h) who is ready to lead, build, and inspire at the intersection of cutting\-edge AI and real\-world media consultancy.
   

  

 You will be part of a high\-impact team in
 **Berlin (hybrid setup)** 
 , shaping the technical direction of our AI Engineering practice. The position is initially limited to 2 years with the option of extension and starts at the earliest possible date.
   

  

**Your Role**
*As a Senior AI Engineer (m/f/d) at ZDF Sparks, you won't just be delivering solutions, you will be setting the standard:*
* Lead \& Grow: You lead AI idea generation, product design, and requirement definitions for complex media industry challenges and you actively grow the next generation of engineers, supporting career paths from junior to senior level while role modeling a positive, agency\-style engineering culture.
* Own it End\-to\-End: You design scientifically state\-of\-the\-art AI products with the ability to evaluate success, ROI, and risks before a project kicks off, architected with a strong understanding of varying levels of technical sovereignty, including diverse cloud environments.
* Build \& Modernize: You design, review, implement, and modernize data systems and algorithms from data analytics to advanced AI/ML solutions and customize and fine\-tune AI models (e.g., text and image generation) for diverse real\-world applications across text, image, audio, and video.
* Make AI Explainable: You open\-source algorithms and translate complex AI logic into something meaningful for larger audiences and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Stay Ahead: You have an inherent passion for following the latest developments in generative AI, computer vision, and recommender systems and you bring that curiosity to everything you do.
* Bridge Builder: You collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including non\-technical media experts, to integrate AI solutions into real business processes.
* Communicate with Impact: You break down complex technical solutions and make them accessible and actionable for non\-technical media professionals.


**Your Profile**
*We're looking for a Senior Engineer (m/f/d) with a builder mindset and a passion for people as much as for technology:*
* 5\+ years of experience in Python\-based software and ML engineering, including data processing, model development, and production\-grade application design.
* Deep expertise in modern ML/DL frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, HuggingFace) and classical ML tooling (scikit\-learn), with a strong foundation in feature engineering, model evaluation, and performance optimization.
* Proven experience architecting and deploying LLM\-powered applications, including RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, and conversational AI systems using frameworks such as LangChain or comparable tooling.
* Solid cloud engineering skills (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including containerization, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure for scalable AI services.
* Track record of designing and delivering end\-to\-end AI solutions, from prototyping and API development through to production deployment and monitoring.
* Thrives in a fast\-paced consultancy setting, comfortable balancing client\-facing advisory work with hands\-on technical delivery in a rapidly evolving AI landscape, including the ability to identify opportunities, shape AI solution proposals, and contribute to business development efforts.
* Experience leading, mentoring, and growing engineers: you define technical direction, conduct code reviews, and foster a culture of excellence.
* Self\-directed and solutions\-oriented: you identify key challenges and independently explore paths forward without waiting for structured tasks.
* Excellent communication skills in English and German.

 **curious, ambitious, and collaborative AI trendsetters** 
 who are excited about working on new and continuously changing customer challenges. We proudly embrace
 **diversity** 
 and enjoy working in
 **fast\-paced, cross\-functional, and multicultural teams.**

 **hybrid work model**

 **personal flexibility and creativity,** 
 enabling a
 **healthy work\-life balance** 
 . We offer
 **flexible working hours** 
 and a hybrid setup to accommodate any personal circumstances.

 **centrally located Berlin top\-floor office**

 **modern spaces with ergonomic workstations**

 **ZDF office partners and visitors over lunches, talks, and afterwork get\-together events** 
 and engage in
 **fun team activities** 
 during regular company events.

 **professional development budget (per employee)**

 **30 days of vacation to recharge (plus off on Christmas Eve and New Years eve).** 
 We also fully cover the cost of the
 **Deutschland\-Jobticket**

title: Founding AI Engineer
description:
**About Jouly** 




  





 Energy managers at German industrial companies spend hours every week manually analyzing meter data, chasing regulatory deadlines, and producing reports that should have been automated. The tools they have weren't built for the complexity they're dealing with.
 



  





 Jouly is building the AI\-powered platform that replaces that workflow. We turn raw energy consumption data into insights, automate regulatory reporting, and help energy managers make better decisions — faster.
 



  





 We're a TU Berlin spin\-off, funded by the Federal Ministry of Economics (BMWK) through the EXIST Gründungsstipendium. The product is being validated with real industrial customers, and the next hire will shape what we build.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 You'll be the first technical hire — joining two co\-founders (Business Informatics \+ Electrical Engineering) to build the core product. This is a founding role with real ownership: you'll make architectural decisions, shape the technical roadmap, and work directly with customers to figure out what matters.
 



  





 We're not looking for someone who executes tickets. We're looking for someone who can look at a messy problem — a chaotic stream of sensor data, a fragmented regulatory workflow, an unrealistic user request — and figure out what to build first.
 



  





**What You'll Work On** 




  




* Building ML pipelines for energy time series data: anomaly detection, load profile analysis, consumption forecasting on meter and sensor data
* Designing and implementing AI agents (LangGraph) that orchestrate analysis, generate regulatory documents, and translate complex data into actionable outputs
* Implementing RAG pipelines grounded in German regulatory documents and customer\-specific knowledge bases
* Building and scaling the web application (Next.js \+ TypeScript \+ Python backend)
* Owning API integrations with energy data providers, IoT/SCADA systems, and government portals (BAFA, BNetzA)
* Helping shape product direction based on what you learn from customers



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  




* Strong Python skills with hands\-on ML experience — especially time series analysis, anomaly detection, or forecasting
* Experience building AI agent systems in production (LangChain/LangGraph, tool use, structured outputs)
* Practical experience with RAG architectures: chunking, retrieval tuning, embedding pipelines
* You've shipped real products to real users, not just trained models in notebooks
* German B2\+ — our customers and regulatory documents are in German. You don't need to be a native speaker, but you need to be able to work with German\-language data and join customer calls.
* A bias for shipping over perfecting



  





 Nice to have:
 


* Experience integrating IoT or SCADA data sources
* AutoML or automated feature engineering experience
* Familiarity with German energy regulations or B2B SaaS
* Full\-stack experience (TypeScript/Next.js)



  






 You don't need to check every box. If you're strong in 3–4 of these and eager to learn the rest, we want to hear from you.
 




  





**What We Offer** 




  




* EXIST stipend (\~2\.500€/month)
* Full technical ownership from day one — no layers, no waiting for approval. You pick the stack, you shape the architecture, you ship.
* Direct access to real customers and real energy data — not a sandbox project
* A front\-row seat in building a product from zero in one of Europe's most important transition sectors
* Hybrid, Berlin\-based (TU Berlin office \+ remote)



  





**How to Apply** 




  





 Send a short note to
 **tim@jouly.ai** 
 with your CV and a few sentences about what you've built and why this problem interests you. No cover letter template needed — we read everything.
 



**Jouly is committed to building a diverse team. We welcome applications from all backgrounds.**

 As a Senior AI Project Manager (m/f/x), you are the technical backbone of our customer engagements.  Lead AI projects end\-to\-end — from requirements engineering and solution architecture through implementation to delivery. Ensure technical decisions are sound, feasible, and aligned with customer objectives

 Drive the design and delivery of AI agent and Generative AI solutions. Guide their integration into enterprise environments with a clear understanding of capabilities and limitations

 A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, or a related field

 You thrive in high\-performing teams, bring a learning mindset, and continuously push yourself and those around you to deliver better outcomes.

 Fluent in both English and German

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**About Us** 




 Resaro was founded on the belief that AI will change the world in ways we cannot even imagine, but every new technology needs safeguards to advance.
 



  





 Resaro builds custom AI testing software that helps organisations validate the performance, robustness, and safety of mission\-critical AI systems — spanning computer vision, generative AI, and autonomous systems. Our clients include government, military, and commercial organisations deploying AI in high\-stakes environments. We work through embedded teams deployed on\-site or closely integrated with our clients.
 



  





 We're looking for an AI Engineer to build models and model\-based features, and integrate AI into our product. This role is more implementation\-focused than research\-focused, but research is part of the job. You'll work across model development, evaluation methodology, synthetic data generation, MLOps, and agentic systems. Depending on your strengths, you may weight toward LLM, computer vision, reinforcement learning, synthetic data, agentic AI, or robotics/edge AI.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 



* Build, deploy, and maintain AI models and model\-based features in production — from fine\-tuning through serving and monitoring.
* Design and implement evaluation methodologies, test plans, and quality frameworks for AI systems (LLM, CV, RL).
* Build agentic AI systems using frameworks like CrewAI, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, and MCP.
* Create synthetic data generation pipelines, adversarial test cases, and benchmark datasets.
* Own model serving infrastructure, MLOps pipelines, and deployment automation.
* Research model behaviour, track global SOTA across domains, and translate findings into product improvements.
* Package and deploy AI capabilities for customer environments, including edge and air\-gapped deployments.
* Contribute to the technical differentiation that makes Resaro's testing products industry\-leading.



  





**What We're Looking For:** 



* 3–7 years of experience in AI/ML engineering, with production deployment experience.
* Strong Python skills and experience with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar).
* Demonstrated depth in at least one domain: LLM/NLP, computer vision, reinforcement learning, or synthetic data generation.
* Experience deploying models to production: model serving, API integration, monitoring, versioning.
* Understanding of evaluation methodology: experimental design, statistical rigour, benchmark creation.
* Ability to bridge research and engineering — read papers, prototype approaches, and ship production code.
* Clear communicator who can explain AI concepts to non\-specialist colleagues and customers.



  





**Nice to Have:** 



* MSc or PhD in AI/ML, Computer Science, or related field.
* Experience with LLM fine\-tuning, RLHF, or prompt engineering at production scale.
* Computer vision expertise: adversarial ML, deepfake detection, AIGC evaluation.
* Reinforcement learning experience: reward modelling, policy evaluation.
* Experience with ROS2, edge AI, simulation (Gazebo/Isaac Sim) for robotics applications.
* Published research or contributions to open\-source AI projects.
* Experience working in defence, pharma, or other regulated industries.
* Experience with air\-gapped or on\-premise deployment environments.



  





**Our Hiring Blueprint** 




 We have deliberately tightened our hiring bar. Every engineer we bring on must meet these standards:
 


* Production\-grade code: You must demonstrate the ability to write clean, tested, maintainable code that ships to production — not just prototypes or notebooks.
* Communication and handover: You must be able to clearly document your work, hand over context to colleagues, and communicate technical decisions to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Independent operation: You must be able to work autonomously with minimal supervision, manage ambiguity, and make sound technical decisions.
* T\-shaped profile: Depth in your primary area plus working knowledge across the stack. We value breadth alongside expertise.

title: AI Software Engineer - Model Evaluation (f/m/d)
description:
Our Mission
   

  

 Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre\-training. Our customers \- in finance, manufacturing, public administration \- need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high\-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.
   

  

 We're growing our pre\-training team and hiring someone to own evaluation: defining what "better" means for our models, building the systems that measure it, and ensuring our training team has the signal it needs to iterate confidently.
   

  

**Team Culture**
 At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision‑making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a
 **Senior AI Engineer in Pre\-training Evaluation** 
 , you will work across the full stack of evaluation \- from methodology design to implementation to analysis. Some weeks you'll be deep in benchmark curation, understanding what a given eval actually measures and whether it predicts downstream performance. Other weeks you'll be optimising pipeline throughput or building dashboards that surface training signals.
   

  

 We are looking for someone that combines significant research experience (in industry or academia) with high engineering competence.
   

  

 Your work sits at high leverage: the evaluations you design and build determine which training runs we pursue, which data mixtures we prioritise, and how we allocate compute. You'll have direct influence on the models we ship.
   

  

 This role is for Aleph Alpha Research GmbH.
   

  

 Your Responsibilities
   

  

* Own benchmarks end\-to\-end: Select, implement, and maintain the evaluation suite used during pre\-training \- from dataset curation to scoring infrastructure to result analysis.
* Build evaluation infrastructure: Develop and optimise the pipelines that run evaluations against training checkpoints, ensuring speed, reliability, and reproducibility.
* Design aggregation and reporting: Define how benchmark results translate into training decisions, and build the tooling that makes results interpretable.
* Close capability gaps: Work with product and post\-training teams to identify where our models fall short, then create or integrate benchmarks that measure progress.
* Own German evaluation: Ensure rigorous assessment of German language capabilities \- this is core to our value proposition, not an afterthought.
* Correlate signals: Establish which pre\-training metrics actually predict downstream and system\-level performance.


 Your Profile
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**

 **crecimiento profesional**

 **transformación de procesos en entornos complejos**

 **inteligencia artificial y agentes autónomos**

 **arquitectura multicloud,** 
 dónde la capa de agentes de IA reside en
 **AWS**

 **Azure Open AI** 
 y se integra con una
 **capa de aplicación de GCP** 
 .
 



 El framework de agentes es
 **LangGraph** 
 y el proveedor de LLM principal es
 **Azure Open AI.** 
 Este stack puede ir evolucionando dependiendo el proyecto y la fase del mismo.
 



 Este rol requiere comprensión del
 **contexto de negocio** 
 , capacidad para definir
 **enfoques analíticos** 
 y habilidad para
 **seleccionar y orquestar las herramientas de IA más adecuadas** 
 para cada proceso. El trabajo en equipo y la orientación a resultados serán clave.

* **Analizar y mapear procesos de negocio** 
 identificando oportunidades de automatización y mejora mediante IA.
* **Diseñar, desarrollar e implementar agentes de IA** 
 con
 **LangGraph** 
 que optimicen procesos operativos dentro del dominio de data modeling financiero
* **Diseñar e implementar el sistema multiagente** 
 compuesto por distintos agentes especializados, deiniendo los roles, flujos de comunicación, estado y memoria de cada agente.
* **Construir y mantener el pipeline de vectorización y RAG** 
 mediante procesamiento de documentos desde S3, generando embeddings, indexación y recuperación semántica por simiulitud que permitan enriquecer los prompt de los agentes.
* **Integrar modelos de IA y LLM’s** 
 para los agentes (modelos de chat y embeddings)
* **Gestionar la memoria de los agentes** 
 a corto y largo plazo así como el checkpoint de workflows como soporte técnico de LangGraph.
* **Diseñar e implementar los guardarraíles de la solución** 
 mediante filtros de contenido, validaciones de inputs/otuputs en el orquestador y lógica de control basada en catálogos de conocimiento.
* **Construir y mantener pipelines de ingesta de datos** 
 robustos para la carga de documentos y su posterior indexación
* **Colaborar con equipos de negocio, datos, infraestructura y seguridad** 
 para asegurar la coherencia técnica y funcional de las soluciones.
* **Documentar arquitecturas, decisiones técnicas y buenas prácticas** 
 para facilitar el gobierno y mantenimiento de las soluciones.







**REQUERIMIENTOS** 




**EXPERIENCIA** 



* Mínimo
 **3\-5 años de experiencia** 
 en proyectos de IA, NLP, LLMs, agentes conversacionales o automatización de procesos.
* Experiencia demostrable en
 **diseño e implementación de sistemas multiagente** 
 con LLMs, incluyendo gestión de estado, memoria y orquestación de flujos complejos.
* Experiencia en
 **implementación del patrón RAG** 
 (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) con bases de datos vectoriales, incluyendo estrategias de chunking, indexación y recuperación semántica.
* Participación en proyectos de
 **transformación digital o automatización en el sector financiero** 
 (banca, seguros, gestión de activos o similar).
* Experiencia trabajando con
 **arquitecturas cloud** 
 , especialmente AWS.
* Experiencia en
 **colaboración con equipos multidisciplinares** 
 (negocio, IT, seguridad, operaciones).







**CONOCIMIENTOS NECESARIOS** 



* **IA y LLMs:** 
 diseño de agentes, prompt engineering avanzado, RAG y patrones de memoria conversacional.
* **Frameworks de agentes:**
* Dominio de
 **LangGraph** 
 (imprescindible) para el desarrollo de agentes y sistemas multiagente, incluyendo gestión de estado con checkpointing y comunicación REST/stateless entre agentes.
* **LangChain** 
 para pipelines de procesamiento documental y RAG. Se eliminan CrewAI y AutoGen que no están homologados en la plataforma GenAI.
* L
 **angMem:** 
 experiencia con LangMem para la gestión de memoria a corto y largo plazo en arquitecturas agentic. Es el mecanismo de memoria homologado en la plataforma.

 App Runner, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, OpenSearch Service y API Gateway.

 experiencia con la API de Azure OpenAI para modelos generativos (gpt\-4o o equivalente) y embeddings (text\-embedding\-3\-large).

 dominio de

 experiencia con
 **OpenSearch** 
 como base de datos vectorial para almacenamiento de embeddings y búsqueda semántica.
* **Bases de datos:** 
 DynamoDB para persistencia de contexto conversacional. PostgreSQL exclusivamente en su rol de soporte técnico para checkpointing de LangGraph.
* **Contenedores:** 
 Docker. Conocimiento del flujo de publicación de imágenes en ECR y despliegue en App Runner.
* **Integración de sistemas:** 
 APIs REST para comunicación entre agentes (patrón stateless).

 nociones de mTLS, gestión de API Keys y mecanismos de autenticación en entornos financieros regulados.

 Familiaridad con

 como runtime del backend de aplicación con el que se
 **integrtan los agentes de AWS**

 calidad, linaje, metadatos y cumplimiento normativo (GDPR, IA Act, regulación financiera).

 familiaridad con herramientas de trazabilidad de LLMs como LangSmith o equivalentes para monitorización del comportamiento de los agentes en producción.

 experiencia combinando búsqueda semántica vectorial con consultas estructuradas a fuentes externas para enriquecer el contexto de los agentes.

 **formación complementaria en inteligencia artificial** 
 , ingeniería de datos o cloud computing.

* Raise the technical bar for how Finom builds, evaluates, and operates AI systems

* Clear in communication and comfortable working across functions

* Hands\-on experience with LLM applications, including some of: RAG, tool use, agents, prompt engineering, evals, structured outputs, guardrails, or fine\-tuning

* Ability to design meaningful evaluation, monitoring, and continuous improvement loops
* Experience with cloud infrastructure and containerized deployments
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to work through ambiguity
* Actively experiments with new AI models, tools, and agentic patterns, and can evaluate which approaches are worth productionizing
* Strong grasp of the fast\-moving AI landscape, with the ability to turn relevant advances into practical product and engineering decisions
* Fluent English


**Nice\-to\-Haves**
* Experience in fintech, financial services, risk, compliance, or operations\-heavy environments
* Experience with applied ML beyond LLMs, such as classification, anomaly detection, ranking, or document intelligence
* Experience with vector databases, knowledge systems, and retrieval infrastructure
* Experience with model benchmarking, experimentation frameworks, and cost or latency optimization at scale
* Background in startups or as a founder
* Contributions to open\-source or visible side projects in AI


**Example Tech Stack**

* Languages: Python, SQL, noSQL

* Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS / GCP / Azure
* Data / Platform: Vector databases, event\-driven systems, APIs, observability tooling

title: Automation and AI Engineer (Unity & Backend Technologies)

Nuestra misión es construir pipelines, herramientas y soluciones impulsadas por IA que automaticen tareas repetitivas, reduzcan la sobrecarga operativa y abran nuevas oportunidades creativas dentro de Product Madness. Este equipo combina una perspectiva de startup con la fuerza de una potencia de juegos bien establecida. Disfrutarás de la agilidad para innovar junto con los recursos para hacer un impacto real.
   

  

 Como Ingeniero/a de Automatización e IA (Tecnologías Unity y Backend), entregarás soluciones completas que se integren eficientemente con nuestras plataformas de juegos Unity y sistemas backend. Tu trabajo impactará las operaciones de juegos en vivo, las experiencias de los jugadores, y el ritmo y la calidad de nuestros ciclos de producción. Trabajarás con diseñadores, científicos de datos, equipos de QA y desarrolladores para componer, construir y lanzar herramientas y flujos de trabajo innovadores usando los últimos desarrollos en IA.
   

  

 Lo que harás
   

  

* Construir, desarrollar y mantener tanto servicios front\-end (Unity) como back\-end (APIs, microservicios, bases de datos) para soportar herramientas y flujos de trabajo de automatización impulsados por sistemas inteligentes.
* Implementar características seguras, escalables y de alto rendimiento que se integren con las bases de código e infraestructuras de juegos existentes.
* Desarrollar y soportar herramientas personalizadas del editor de Unity para agilizar tareas repetitivas, como flujos de trabajo de creación de contenido, pipelines de construcción y verificaciones de rendimiento.
* Aprovechar las APIs de scripting de Unity para integrar servicios de IA y automatizar pasos manuales en los procesos de desarrollo y operaciones en vivo.
* Desarrollar y optimizar aplicaciones del lado del servidor y microservicios que potencian características de IA, procesamiento de datos y análisis en tiempo real.
* Colaborar con DevOps en pipelines de CI/CD para automatizar pruebas, despliegues y monitoreo de soluciones impulsadas por inteligencia artificial.
* Trabajar estrechamente con científicos de datos y especialistas en IA para integrar modelos de aprendizaje automático, agentes autónomos y otras técnicas avanzadas de IA en sistemas Unity y backend.
* Evaluar herramientas y frameworks emergentes de IA para determinar su viabilidad, puntos de integración y retorno de inversión para el negocio.
* Implementar estrategias de pruebas automatizadas (unitarias, de integración, funcionales, regresivas) para garantizar la fiabilidad y mantenibilidad de sistemas nuevos y existentes.
* Colaborar con desarrolladores de juegos, arquitectos y gestores de producto para identificar desafíos y oportunidades de aplicación de automatización e IA.
* Documentar construcciones, flujos de trabajo y directrices para una adopción interna más amplia.
* Buscar activamente áreas para optimización, nuevas herramientas o mejoras de procesos, y mantenerse informado/a sobre las últimas tendencias en IA, juegos y automatización.


 Lo que buscamos
   

  

* Más de 5 años de experiencia profesional en desarrollo full stack, preferiblemente en un entorno de juegos.
* Más de un año de experiencia profesional en desarrollo e implementación de IA y Automatización.
* Dominio de Unity (C\#) con experiencia demostrada en la creación de herramientas del editor, módulos de juegos o características de operaciones en vivo.
* Experiencia sólida en desarrollo de back\-end con un lenguaje moderno (por ejemplo, Java, C\#, Python o Node.js) y frameworks (por ejemplo, ASP.NET, Django, Express).
* Experiencia con bases de datos (SQL y/o NoSQL) y creación de APIs RESTful o arquitecturas de microservicios.
* Familiaridad con prácticas y herramientas de DevOps y CI/CD (Git, Docker, Jenkins, etc.).
* Sólida comprensión de las directrices de ingeniería de software (patrones de construcción, revisiones de código, pruebas y control de versiones).
* Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo, con la capacidad de trabajar de manera transversal en un entorno ágil.


 Valoramos
   

  

* Experiencia con frameworks de IA/ML (TensorFlow, PyTorch, APIs de OpenAI) o integración de servicios de IA de terceros.
* Experiencia con plataformas en la nube (AWS, Azure o GCP) incluyendo computación sin servidor, orquestación de contenedores (Kubernetes) e infraestructura como código.
* Familiaridad con análisis de juegos, sistemas multijugador en tiempo real u otras tecnologías relacionadas con operaciones en vivo.
* Pasión por los juegos e interés en el futuro del desarrollo de juegos utilizando tecnología avanzada.

 Como parte de la familia Aristocrat, compartimos su misión de llenar de alegría la vida gracias al poder del juego, con un equipo de primer nivel que crea títulos líderes y de mayor recaudación en el género de casino social, entre ellos Heart of Vegas, Lightning Link y Cashman Casino.

 Nos guiamos por nuestro principio de “Las personas primero”. Independientemente de dónde, cuándo o cómo trabajen, los miembros de nuestro equipo tienen oportunidades para avanzar en su carrera profesional y crecer con nosotros. Nos enorgullece fomentar una cultura inclusiva, en la que se anima a cada persona a dar lo mejor de sí misma cada día.
   

  

 Pero no confíes solo en nuestra palabra. En 2024, fuimos incluidos en la lista de los Global Inspiring Workplace Awards y recibimos un premio de bronce en los Stevies for Great Employers, en la categoría de “Empleador del año \- Medios de comunicación y entretenimiento”.

 Ninguna

 We aim to revolutionize hardware design and simulation in these industries and are building a team of highly motivated professionals to bring these innovations from research into commercial products.

 As an Senior Applied AI Engineer, you are the bridge between AI research and production software. You will:

* Design and implement LLM\-powered product features (agents, tools, prompting strategies) using frameworks like PydanticAI (or similar)
* Make principled trade\-offs between models and approaches (quality, latency, cost, privacy, reliability)

* Production Engineering \& Quality
+ Write production\-grade code: clear abstractions, solid API boundaries, strong typing where appropriate, and consistent error handling
+ Define and enforce testing practices for applied AI (unit tests, integration tests, golden/regression tests)
+ Implement instrumentation appropriate for debugging and iteration (basic logging/tracing/metrics for AI features)
+ Ensure reliability and security basics: rate limiting where needed, safe input handling, prompt\-injection awareness, and sensible defaults

* Collaboration \& Enablement
+ Work with AI Developers to productionize their experiments regarding improving user workflows
+ Define workflows: notebook/test repository → PR → staging → production
+ Document AI infrastructure and best practices
+ Review code and mentor AI developers on software practices


**Key Requirements**

* Experience with LLMs and AI/ML in production: OpenAI API, HuggingFace, LangChain, or similar (beyond prototypes)
* Strong software engineering fundamentals: design patterns, code structure, testing practices, and code review habits
* Cloud infrastructure experience: GCP (Vertex AI preferred) or AWS (SageMaker)
* API/service development experience (e.g., FastAPI/REST/async programming) and collaboration across teams
* CI/CD and DevOps: Docker, Terraform, GitHub Actions
* Monitoring and observability
* Problem\-solving mindset: comfortable debugging complex distributed systems
* Operating experience with AI deployment in enterprise environment
* Excellent communication: able to work directly with users, capture requirements, and explain trade\-offs clearly


**Nice\-to\-Have**
* Experience fine\-tuning or training models
* Familiarity with LangChain, Pydantic AI or similar frameworks
* Knowledge of prompt engineering and evaluation techniques
* Experience with real\-time inference and streaming responses
* Background in data engineering or ML engineering
* Understanding of RAG architectures
* Contributions to open\-source AI/ML projects


**What We Offer**
* Competitive compensation
* Stock Options Plan: Empowering you to share in our success and growth.
* Cutting\-Edge Tools: Access to state\-of\-the\-art tools and collaborative opportunities with leading experts in artificial intelligence, physics, hardware and electronic design automation.
* Work\-Life Balance: Flexible work arrangements in one of our offices with potential options for remote work.
* Professional Growth: Opportunities to attend industry conferences, present research findings, and engage with the global AI research community.
* Impact\-Driven Culture: Join a passionate team focused on solving some of the most challenging problems at the intersection of AI and hardware.


**Why join us?**
 At Axiomatic\_AI, you will be working on technology that drives innovation in AI for scientific and engineering applications in line with our 30 x 30 mission.
   

  

 This is your opportunity to contribute to the development of new AI architectures that can reason coherently and produce interpretable and verifiable solutions. Consequently, see those ideas commercialized into products that will shape the future of hardware and computing, while collaborating with a global team of engineers and AI specialists.
   

  

 We believe in pushing the boundaries of what is possible and continuously seek to redefine the intersection of AI, with focus on formal consistency. If you're ready to take your expertise in artificial intelligence and physics to the next level, we want to hear from you!

If this role excites you but your background doesn’t perfectly match every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You could be the perfect fit for this position or another opportunity with us.*

description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025\. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.  


**What You'll Do:**
-------------------



The Monolith AI Engineering Team at CoreWeave is responsible for building and scaling the core platform that powers the world's most advanced engineering simulation and AI workflows — our ambition is to become the **super‑intelligent AI test lab** for the engineering industry, helping customers "ship science, faster." From evolving distributed architecture to enabling the next generation of agentic interfaces and physical AI, this team delivers the performant, reliable, and scalable foundation trusted by the world's largest engineering companies.



The Fullstack Engineer (Frontend Focus) will own and evolve the Monolith platform's product surface — the data‑heavy, workflow‑centric web experience where engineers design experiments, compare runs, interact with agents, and turn complex physical test data into decisions. You'll partner closely with Design, Product, and Backend Engineering to ship UI and UX that feel fast, intuitive, and trustworthy for non‑ML expert engineers, while also contributing to our Python backend services when needed.


**About the Role:**
-------------------



We're targeting an IC5 **Fullstack Staff Engineer** with a strong frontend background, and are also open to exceptional **Senior Fullstack Engineer II (IC4\)** candidates who can operate at staff‑like scope. The role is **heavily frontend‑weighted** (roughly 80–90%), focused on owning the Monolith web application: component architecture, design system evolution, performance, and UX for complex, data‑rich workflows. You'll also work across our Python services (FastAPI/Flask) to shape and integrate APIs, bring new platform capabilities to the UI, and occasionally deliver backend features that unlock better user experiences.



You'll be a key partner in defining how engineers experience Monolith's "AI test lab" — from agent chat to experiment exploration and monitoring — and will help set the bar for frontend quality, reliability, and developer experience across the team.



In this role, you will:


**Frontend Ownership \& Experience**


* Own significant areas of the Monolith frontend, from architecture and component design to implementation, refactors, and ongoing maintenance.
* Design and build modern, responsive UIs using React and TypeScript, with a focus on complex, data‑heavy views (tables, charts, experiment timelines, dashboards, agents) that remain fast and understandable for users.
* Collaborate with Design to evolve our design system and component library, ensuring consistency, accessibility, and a high‑quality visual language across the product.
* Drive frontend performance improvements (bundle size, rendering strategies, network usage) to keep the app responsive even under large datasets and long‑running workflows.
* Champion accessibility and usability, ensuring the interface works well for time‑pressed engineers in demanding environments.


**Fullstack Development \& Platform Integration**


* Work closely with backend engineers on our Python services to design clean API contracts, shape data models for UI needs, and debug issues across the stack.
* Implement and integrate backend functionality (primarily in Python) when it materially improves UX or unlocks new workflows, including occasional work on API endpoints, background tasks, and data transformations.
* Collaborate with our agent and platform teams to expose agentic capabilities (e.g. platform agent) safely and intuitively in the frontend experience.
* Contribute to fullstack observability — instrumenting both frontend and backend for metrics, logging, and tracing, and using that data to guide product and performance improvements.


**Collaboration, Quality \& Developer Experience**


* Work hand‑in‑hand with Product and Design to scope projects, define success criteria, and break down ambiguous problems into iterative deliverables.
* Maintain a high bar for code quality through thoughtful design, code reviews, tests (unit, integration, and E2E), and documentation.
* Help improve our frontend developer experience — build tooling, workflows, and patterns that make it easier for the team to ship reliable UI quickly (Storybook/design‑system improvements, local dev ergonomics, CI checks, etc.).
* Mentor other engineers on frontend best practices, UX thinking, and effective fullstack collaboration.

**Who You Are:**
----------------


**Experience \& Level**


* Typically **7\+ years of professional software engineering experience**, including substantial time building and maintaining complex, user‑facing web applications as a fullstack or frontend‑leaning engineer.
* A track record of operating at **Senior/Staff** scope: owning significant product surface area, driving cross‑team projects, and making architectural decisions that last.


**Frontend Expertise**


* Advanced proficiency in **React** and **TypeScript**, with experience structuring large‑scale frontends (modules, state management, routing, data‑fetching patterns).
* Strong command of web fundamentals
* Experience building **data‑heavy and visualization‑centric UIs** — e.g. dashboards, charts, time‑series visualizations, experiment or metrics explorers.
* Familiarity with **design systems** and component libraries (Storybook or similar), and an eye for when design details materially impact user trust and productivity.


**Backend \& Platform Skills**


* Solid experience with **Python** in production environments (FastAPI, Flask, or Django), including building and integrating REST or GraphQL APIs that power frontend experiences.
* Comfortable working in **service‑oriented** or microservice architectures, reasoning about data flows, failure modes, and performance across boundaries.
* Experience with **SQL** databases (e.g. PostgreSQL) and practical data modelling for product features.
* Familiarity with modern cloud and container stacks (Docker, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider).


**Quality \& Ways of Working**


* Strong habits around testing (unit, integration, and E2E) and CI/CD for frontend and backend changes.
* Effective collaborator with Product, Design, and cross‑functional stakeholders; clear written and verbal communicator who can explain trade‑offs and constraints.
* Comfortable working in a fast‑moving, high‑ambiguity environment where we balance shipping quickly with maintaining a reliable platform.

### **Preferred:**


* Experience building UIs for **technical or data‑savvy users** (ML engineers, data scientists, physical test engineers, or similar), especially in B2B SaaS products.
* Familiarity with **GraphQL** and typed API clients in React (or strong REST plus a desire to pick up GraphQL quickly).
* Experience with SSR/SSG frameworks, particularly for performance‑sensitive dashboards.
* Prior work with **time‑series and experiment tracking** tooling, ML platforms, or analytics products.

* Experience with frontend observability (Sentry, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, etc.) and using telemetry to guide UX improvements.

### **Wondering if you're a good fit?**



We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams — even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we've found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk.


* **Product‑minded craftsperson** – you care as much about the user experience and clarity of a workflow as you do about the quality of the code behind it.

 You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing...**
 You will be working to design, deploy, and
 **optimise** 
 Generative AI solutions that solve real\-world problems for our customers and internal teams. You will move beyond traditional
 **modelling** 
 to build agentic workflows and RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) systems, applying the latest advancements in Foundation Models to create intuitive, AI\-native product experiences.
   

  

* Building and refining LLM\-powered features and autonomous agents to enhance product capabilities and business logic.
* Designing and implementing RAG pipelines to connect our proprietary data with large language models for high\-accuracy outputs.
* Exploring the frontier of AI research (e.g., new model releases, context window techniques, and prompting strategies) to rapidly prototype and integrate commercial and open\-source models.
* Collaborating with Product Managers and UX Designers to define how AI can best serve user needs and improve interaction patterns.
* Developing and maintaining production\-grade infrastructure for AI orchestration, including prompt management and model evaluation frameworks.
* Optimising AI performance through Prompt Engineering, context management, and strategic use of embeddings.
* Contributing to a culture of rapid experimentation and "AI\-first" thinking across the engineering organisation.
* Rapid "Vibe Coding" \& Prototyping: Use tools like Lovable, Bolt.new, and Claude Code to go from idea to deployed full\-stack MVP in days, not weeks.
* AI Evangelism \& Enablement: Act as the "AI Copilot" for the R\&D team. Run internal workshops, create "cursor rules" files for the team, and teach senior engineers how to leverage AI tools to 10x their speed.


**What We’re Looking For...**
 You are a builder at heart with a "hacker" mindset. You are eager to bridge the gap between raw model capabilities and polished user products. You are proactive, iterate quickly, and enjoy the challenge of "taming" non\-deterministic AI outputs.
   

  

**You’ll Need To Have**
* Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or a related technical field.
* Strong proficiency in Python.
* Solid understanding of the LLM stack, including experience with orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Strands Agents, CrewAI).
* Knowledge of modern AI concepts: Prompt Engineering, few\-shot learning, and the difference between fine\-tuning and RAG.
* Experience with standard software development tools (Git, Docker) and CI/CD processes.


**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**
* Evangelist Energy: You are genuinely excited about AI. You follow the latest releases, read the relevant papers, and can explain why "reasoning models" matter to a non\-technical stakeholder.
* Fearless "Hacker" Mindset: You aren't afraid of code you didn't write. You are comfortable generating 80% of your code with AI and crafting the remaining 20% with high precision.
* Contributions to open\-source AI projects or a portfolio of "weekend" prototypes built with an AI\-native toolchain (e.g. Lovable, Replit, Cursor, Claude Code, Gitlab Copilot).
* Exposure to cloud\-based AI services (e.g., AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Studio, or GCP Vertex AI)
* Experience with Vector Databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, or Chroma) and semantic search concepts.
* Experience with AI evaluation and observability tools (e.g., LangSmith, LangFuse).
* Experience deploying models locally using tools like Ollama or vLLM.
* Knowledge of "Agentic" design patterns (e.g., ReAct, Tool\-use/Function calling).


 Where you’ll be working
   

  

 In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
   

  

 Scheduled Weekly Hours
   

  

 37\.5
   

  

 Equal Employment Opportunity
   

  

 Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Principal AI Engineer
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Principal AI Engineer
   

  

**Overview**
 Mastercard Foundry is a global innovation group focused on the evolution of technology and consumer trends and how these changes impact the payments and commerce industry. Foundry is a collective of interdisciplinary teams powering Mastercard's ability to create and deliver differentiated products, services, and experiences.
   

  

 Within Foundry, the global Research and Development (R\&D) team conducts applied research on emerging technologies to create innovative products for Mastercard. Foundry R\&D is made up of talented, passionate developers, engineers, scientists, designers, researchers, data specialists, and program managers. We build knowledge in emerging technologies like agentic AI, generative AI and machine learning to conceptualize and create new products and services, which we then market test with our customers. We also bring the knowledge of cutting and bleeding edge technology to create concepts of the future which not only inspires our customers but also fosters the culture of innovation within Mastercard.
   

  

 To support this range of projects we are looking for a talented Principal AI Engineer to join the Mastercard Foundry R\&D team in our Dublin TechHub.
   

  

 Role
   

  

 As a Principal AI Engineer at Mastercard, you will be a key member of our AI delivery team, responsible for designing, building, and scaling AI microservices that transform proof\-of\-concept (PoC) notebooks into robust, production\-ready components. Working closely with data scientists, MLOps engineers, and cross\-functional partners, you will enable the seamless integration of AI services into the broader Mastercard ecosystem. This role offers a unique opportunity to bridge engineering and AI best practices in Applied AI.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* AI Microservice Design: Design and lead implementation of AI\-powered microservices (e.g., ML, agentic AI) with a focus on modularity, scalability, and reusability to support diverse business units and solutions.
* Productionalization: Transition AI models and agentic workflows from notebook\-based PoCs to production\-grade components, ensuring performance, reliability, and maintainability.
* API Development: Design and lead implementation of robust APIs for AI microservices to facilitate seamless integration within the Mastercard ecosystem.
* Quality Assurance: Lead the development of testing strategies (unit, integration, performance) to ensure the accuracy, stability, and quality of deployed AI services.
* Performance Optimization: Identify and address bottlenecks in AI microservices and infrastructure, optimizing for latency, throughput, and cost efficiency.
* Pipeline Development: Work with data science and infrastructure teams to design reusable workflows (e.g., feature engineering, model \& agent optimization, evaluation pipelines).
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with data scientists, MLOps engineers, product owners, and external stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical specifications.
* Technology Innovation: Research and evaluate emerging technologies (e.g., LLMs, frameworks, methodologies) to enhance AI software development and large\-scale data processing capabilities.
* Compliance \& Ethics: Ensure all AI microservices adhere to Mastercard’s security standards, compliance policies, and ethical AI principles, while contributing to AI engineering best practices.


**Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field. Master’s degree preferred.
* Experience: Minimum of 10\+ years in software development, with at least 5 years focused on building and deploying AI/ML, GenAI, AgenticAI powered applications or microservices in production environments.


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Strong proficiency in Python, Java and relevant frameworks (e.g., Spring Boot, Spring AI, FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel).
* Extensive experience designing, developing, and deploying RESTful APIs and microservices.
* Proficiency with containerization technologies.
* Proven experience delivering GenAI, Agentic AI workflows in production.
* Proven experience scaling machine learning models from prototype to production, including familiarity with feature stores, model registries, and inference patterns.
* Solid understanding of the AI/ML lifecycle, from data preparation and model training to deployment and monitoring.
* Experience with cloud platforms and their relevant compute, storage, and AI/ML services, cloud certification preferred.
* Solid understanding of ML, Deep Learning.
* Solid understanding of neural network and transformer model architecture.
* Solid experience of CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment of software and AI models.
* Understanding of data governance, data quality, and data security principles relevant to AI/ML applications.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to effectively articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non technical audiences.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**Job Title: Lead AI Engineer, Education**

**Position Summary**


The Lead AI Engineer, Education is a high\-impact, enterprise\-facing role within McKesson's Enterprise Analytics \& AI Strategy organization. This role is equal parts AI evangelist, technical educator, and organizational change agent responsible for driving deep AI understanding and confident adoption across the full spectrum of McKesson's workforce, from C\-suite executives to frontline operators. The role goes beyond awareness, it builds genuine technical fluency in AI concepts, tools, and applications across business functions including Finance, HR, Supply Chain, Operations, Legal, and Technology, meeting each audience exactly where they are.


The Lead AI Engineer, Education serves as McKesson's most visible internal champion for AI making the case for why AI matters, what it can do, and how every employee can leverage it to work smarter and deliver better outcomes. This role is a cornerstone of McKesson's AI strategy, ensuring that enterprise\-wide AI adoption is not just top\-down mandated but bottom\-up embraced powered by deep understanding, relevant skills, and an organization\-wide culture of AI curiosity and innovation.

 **Key Responsibilities**

**AI Evangelism \& Culture Leadership**

* Serve as McKesson's primary internal AI evangelist building excitement, urgency, and confidence around AI adoption across all levels of the organization, from board\-level leadership to day\-to\-day operators.
* Design and lead enterprise\-wide AI awareness and evangelism campaigns through McKesson's AI Hub, Viva Engage, internal newsletters, leadership forums, AI podcasts, and town halls making AI accessible, relevant, and compelling for every audience.
* Develop and deliver executive briefings and leadership narratives that connect AI capabilities directly to McKesson's strategic priorities, financial outcomes, and competitive positioning in clear, business\-outcome language for C\-suite and ELT audiences.
* Build and scale a McKesson AI Champions Network identifying, enabling, and sustaining AI ambassadors within every business function to drive grassroots AI enthusiasm and peer\-driven adoption.
* Create compelling AI storytelling assets success story spotlights, use\-case case studies, demo videos, infographics, and impact narratives that translate real McKesson AI wins into inspiration for broader enterprise adoption.
**Deep Technical AI Education — Audience\-Adaptive Curriculum**

* Design, build, and deliver a comprehensive, audience\-adaptive AI education program calibrated by role, technical depth, and business context:
**Audience‑Specific Curriculum Focus**

**C‑Suite:** Focus areas include AI strategy, competitive landscape, GenAI ROI, risk and governance, and decision‑making with AI.

**Business Leaders:** Curriculum emphasizes use‑case identification, AI ROI frameworks, responsible AI, and leading AI‑enabled teams.

**Business Analysts / Finance / HR:** Training covers Copilot productivity, prompt engineering, data‑driven decision‑making, and AI‑assisted workflows.

**Data \& Technology Teams:** Deep technical modules on LLM architecture, RAG pipelines, MLOps, agentic AI, Azure AI Foundry, and fine‑tuning.

**Frontline Operators:** Focus on practical AI tool adoption (Copilot Chat, Copilot Agents), workflow automation, and foundational AI safety.

* Develop deep technical curriculum covering the following AI/ML and LLM concepts taught accessibly to non\-technical audiences and rigorously to technical ones:

description:

**Job Title: Lead AI Engineer, Education**
**Position Summary**
 The Lead AI Engineer, Education is a high\-impact, enterprise\-facing role within McKesson's Enterprise Analytics \& AI Strategy organization. This role is equal parts AI evangelist, technical educator, and organizational change agent responsible for driving deep AI understanding and confident adoption across the full spectrum of McKesson's workforce, from C\-suite executives to frontline operators. The role goes beyond awareness, it builds genuine technical fluency in AI concepts, tools, and applications across business functions including Finance, HR, Supply Chain, Operations, Legal, and Technology, meeting each audience exactly where they are.
   

  

 The Lead AI Engineer, Education serves as McKesson's most visible internal champion for AI making the case for why AI matters, what it can do, and how every employee can leverage it to work smarter and deliver better outcomes. This role is a cornerstone of McKesson's AI strategy, ensuring that enterprise\-wide AI adoption is not just top\-down mandated but bottom\-up embraced powered by deep understanding, relevant skills, and an organization\-wide culture of AI curiosity and innovation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**AI Evangelism \& Culture Leadership**
* Serve as McKesson's primary internal AI evangelist building excitement, urgency, and confidence around AI adoption across all levels of the organization, from board\-level leadership to day\-to\-day operators.
* Design and lead enterprise\-wide AI awareness and evangelism campaigns through McKesson's AI Hub, Viva Engage, internal newsletters, leadership forums, AI podcasts, and town halls making AI accessible, relevant, and compelling for every audience.
* Develop and deliver executive briefings and leadership narratives that connect AI capabilities directly to McKesson's strategic priorities, financial outcomes, and competitive positioning in clear, business\-outcome language for C\-suite and ELT audiences.
* Build and scale a McKesson AI Champions Network identifying, enabling, and sustaining AI ambassadors within every business function to drive grassroots AI enthusiasm and peer\-driven adoption.
* Create compelling AI storytelling assets success story spotlights, use\-case case studies, demo videos, infographics, and impact narratives that translate real McKesson AI wins into inspiration for broader enterprise adoption.


**Deep Technical AI Education — Audience\-Adaptive Curriculum**
* Design, build, and deliver a comprehensive, audience\-adaptive AI education program calibrated by role, technical depth, and business context:


**Audience‑Specific Curriculum Focus**
**C‑Suite:** 
 Focus areas include AI strategy, competitive landscape, GenAI ROI, risk and governance, and decision‑making with AI.
   

  

**Business Leaders:** 
 Curriculum emphasizes use‑case identification, AI ROI frameworks, responsible AI, and leading AI‑enabled teams.
   

  

**Business Analysts / Finance / HR:** 
 Training covers Copilot productivity, prompt engineering, data‑driven decision‑making, and AI‑assisted workflows.
   

  

**Data \& Technology Teams:** 
 Deep technical modules on LLM architecture, RAG pipelines, MLOps, agentic AI, Azure AI Foundry, and fine‑tuning.
   

  

**Frontline Operators:** 
 Focus on practical AI tool adoption (Copilot Chat, Copilot Agents), workflow automation, and foundational AI safety.
   

  

* Develop deep technical curriculum covering the following AI/ML and LLM concepts taught accessibly to non\-technical audiences and rigorously to technical ones:
* Large Language Models (LLMs): transformer architecture, tokenization, context windows, embeddings, attention mechanisms, pre\-training vs. fine\-tuning, and model evaluation.
* Generative AI: how GenAI models work, diffusion models, multimodal AI, image/text/code generation, and enterprise GenAI application patterns.
* Prompt Engineering: zero\-shot, few\-shot, chain\-of\-thought, structured prompting, system prompts, and role\-based prompting with function\-specific use case labs.
* Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG): grounding LLMs in enterprise data, vector databases, chunking strategies, embedding models, and RAG pipeline architecture.
* Agentic AI \& Multi\-Agent Systems: what agents are, how they reason and act, orchestration patterns, tool use, Copilot Agents, and when to deploy agents vs. standard AI tools.
* Machine Learning Fundamentals: supervised/unsupervised learning, model training, overfitting, evaluation metrics, and ML lifecycle management.
* Responsible AI \& AI Governance: hallucination risks, bias and fairness, data privacy in AI usage, McKesson's Acceptable Use Policy, AIRB approval process, and ethical AI principles.
* AI in Business Functions: function\-specific deep dives Finance (forecasting, variance analysis, contract summarization), HR (talent analytics, policy agents, JD drafting), Supply Chain (demand forecasting, anomaly detection), Operations (workflow automation, predictive maintenance).


**McKesson AI Tool Stack — Hands\-On Enablement**
 Design, facilitate, and scale hands\-on training programs across McKesson's full enterprise AI toolkit:
   

  

**Productivity \& Collaboration AI**
* Microsoft 365 Copilot — Copilot in Teams, Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint; Intelligent Recap, email summarization, document drafting, and meeting intelligence.
* Microsoft Copilot Chat — Secure, enterprise\-grade AI chat for all McKesson employees for Q\&A, content generation, and workflow support.
* Copilot Agents — No\-code intelligent agents for automating repetitive tasks, decision support, and business workflow automation.
* GitHub Copilot — AI\-accelerated coding, documentation, code review, and issue resolution for technical teams.


**Generative AI \& Development Platforms**
* Azure OpenAI Service — Enterprise LLM APIs (GPT\-4o, GPT\-4 Turbo, o1, o3\) for custom GenAI applications, RAG pipelines, and intelligent agent development.
* Anthropic Claude (Claude Models \& Claude Code) — Advanced frontier LLM capabilities including Claude 3\.5/3\.7 Sonnet, Claude Opus, and Claude Code for agentic coding, long\-context reasoning, document analysis, and complex multi\-step task automation; a key complement to OpenAI models in McKesson's enterprise GenAI stack.
* Azure AI Foundry — Unified platform for building, evaluating, and deploying enterprise\-grade AI models and GenAI applications across multiple model providers including OpenAI and Anthropic.
* Azure Databricks — Unified data and AI platform supporting ML model development, LLMOps, GenAI app development, RAG pipelines, and fine\-tuning at enterprise scale.
* Azure Machine Learning (Azure ML) — Enterprise MLOps for model training, deployment, governance, and monitoring.
* LangChain / Agentic AI Frameworks — Orchestration frameworks for multi\-agent AI systems and complex GenAI workflows.
* Codeium / Windsurf — AI\-powered code completion and developer productivity for advanced engineering teams.
* Exafunction — GPU compute optimization for AI model training and inference workloads.


**Governance \& Program Tools**
* AI Hub (SharePoint) — McKesson's central AI resource hub for governance, learning, tool access, use\-case submission, and community connection.
* Responsible AI Use Case Intake (AIRB / Smartsheet) — AI Review Board submission and approval workflow for enterprise AI use cases.
* Workday Learning / Viva Learning / MyLearning / LinkedIn Learning — Enterprise learning platforms for deploying and tracking AI curricula at scale.


**Cross\-Functional Stakeholder Engagement**
* Serve as the primary liaison between the Enterprise AI team and all business functions translating AI capabilities into audience\-appropriate learning and enablement experiences.
* Collaborate with HR/L\&D, Change Management, and Internal Communications to embed AI education into enterprise talent development programs and communications channels.
* Partner with AI engineers, data scientists, and product teams to keep all curricula current with tools, platforms, and use cases in active production.
* Represent AI Education priorities in governance forums, BU pod meetings, and Enterprise AI Steering Committees.


**Program Management \& Impact Measurement**
* Own the AI Education \& Evangelism roadmap — define milestones, track adoption KPIs (MAU, WAU, training completions, use cases enabled), and report outcomes to senior leadership.
* Maintain the AI Hub Education section as the single source of truth for all AI learning content, resources, and governance updates.

* Identify and manage external training vendors and content partners (e.g., Microsoft, Anthropic, LinkedIn Learning, Databricks Academy) as needed to supplement internal curriculum.


**Minimum Job Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in AI/ML, data science, enterprise technology, or a related field — with demonstrated strength in evangelism, education, or capability building.
* At least 5 years in a lead or senior IC capacity with proven ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders at all levels.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Instructional Design, or a related field.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
**AI/ML \& LLM Technical Depth**
* Solid understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) — including transformer architecture, tokenization, context windows, embeddings, pre\-training vs. fine\-tuning, prompt engineering (zero\-shot, few\-shot, chain\-of\-thought), and RAG pipeline fundamentals.

title: AI E-Commerce Operator
company: Lake House Group | Shopify & Klaviyo Agency
description:
This role didn't exist a year ago. It exists now because AI has changed what one person can deliver in Shopify, and we've built the tools to prove it. We're looking for someone who wants to operate at that new frontier: executing Shopify work faster and better than anyone thought possible, using AI coding agents and their own deep platform knowledge. If you need a job that looks like every other Shopify job, this isn't it. If you want to define what the next generation of e\-commerce execution looks like, keep reading.
 



  





  





**The Role** 




 The AI E\-Commerce Operator will execute Shopify tasks for clients across Lake House Group's portfolio, using our proprietary Shopify coding agent to build sections, add features, and fix bugs, combined with hands\-on Shopify admin work where AI can't reach yet. You'll receive tasks from our Product Owners and deliver at a pace and quality level that wasn't possible before these tools existed.
 



 You're the person who makes things happen inside Shopify stores. You'll also help us refine how we make things happen, feeding back what works and what doesn't into our AI workflows. You'll also work with our Klaviyo agent on email and SMS\-related tasks as the tooling evolves.
 



 There is no "typical week" for this role. What you do in month one won't look like what you do in month three. The scope will expand as the tools improve and as you push their limits. You'll work directly with our AI engineer when you need access to the latest capabilities or hit advanced technical questions. Your job is to operate at the edge of what's possible and report back what you find.
 



 You'll be expected to stay on top of what's happening in AI and e\-commerce. On X, in newsletters, in communities. This isn't optional. The landscape moves weekly, and so does this role.
 



  





  





**Reality Check** 




 Lake House has tripled in size over 3 years and is aiming to do it again. We've built proprietary AI tools that change how e\-commerce work gets done. This role is part of that bet.
 



 The tools are real and working. But they're also evolving. You'll sometimes be the first person to test a new capability. Things will break. Workflows will change. What you do in month one won't look like what you do in month six. That's the point.
 



 You're not joining a polished operation with a fixed playbook. You're joining a team that's building the playbook while delivering real work for real clients. If that sounds exhausting, it probably isn't the right fit. If it sounds exciting, it probably is.
 



  





  





**Non\-Negotiables** 




**2\+ years working in Shopify.** 
 You know the admin inside out. Products, collections, metafields, metaobjects, themes, apps, Flow. You don't need a tutorial to navigate the platform.
 



**Advanced AI user.** 
 You've gone way beyond chatting with an AI. You've built custom skills, used coding agents like Claude Code to ship real work, automated workflows with AI, or pushed tools into territory they weren't designed for. We'll ask you to show us. If your AI experience is limited to asking ChatGPT to rewrite an email, this isn't the role.
 



**Obsessively current.** 
 You follow AI and e\-commerce developments daily. On X, in newsletters, in communities. You can tell us what happened this week. If we have to tell you about the latest Shopify or AI news, it's probably not the right fit.
 



**Comfortable with technical concepts.** 
 You don't need to write production code, but you understand how Liquid templates work, what an API does, how theme sections are structured. When the coding agent produces output, you can evaluate whether it's right.
 



**Detail\-oriented executor.** 
 You catch what others miss. You test before you ship. You care about the quality of what goes live on a client's store.
 



**Based in Montreal.** 
 Hybrid work from our downtown WeWork office.
 



  





  





**This Role Is Not For You If** 




**You need a clear, stable job description.** 
 There's no established career path called "AI E\-Commerce Operator." The expectations will shift as the tools and the business evolve. If ambiguity stresses you out, this won't work.
 



**You resist changing how you work.** 
 The coding agent gets better constantly. What required manual work last month might be fully automated next month. If you want to keep doing things the way you've always done them, you'll fall behind here.
 



**You trade speed for quality.** 
 You'll be able to deliver more than a traditional Shopify operator. But "more" doesn't mean "sloppy." The quality bar stays high even as throughput increases.
 



**You prefer deep focus on one thing.** 
 You'll work across several brands in a given week. Context switching is part of the job.
 



  





  





**What Makes Someone Succeed Here** 




 You're genuinely curious about AI and what it can do. Not as hype, but as a tool. You test things on your own time. You've probably broken a few things experimenting. You don't wait to be told what to try. You try it and report back. You're rigorous about the details even when moving fast. You care about getting it right, not just getting it done. You communicate clearly when something doesn't work or when you spot a better way. You're comfortable saying "I don't know yet, but I'll figure it out."
 



  





  





**What You'll Learn \& Grow Into** 




 How AI agents actually work in production. Not theory, real daily execution. Deep Shopify mastery across complex multi\-market, multi\-catalog implementations. How to evaluate, improve, and push the limits of AI\-powered workflows. A front\-row seat to how an agency is redefining e\-commerce services. The skills to operate in a category that barely exists today but will define e\-commerce operations in the years ahead.
 



**You'll have access to unlimited AI tokens.** 
 If that sentence excites you, you're probably right for this role.
 



  





  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive salary, discussed during the interview process.
* Hybrid work. A mix of working from home and from our downtown Montreal WeWork office.
* Wellness and cell phone allocation.
* Unlimited access to AI tools. We invest in the infrastructure so you can push limits.
* Room to grow. Small team means real impact.
* Learning environment. This is a team that's obsessed with getting better.
* Autonomy.



  





  





**About Lake House Group** 




 Lake House Group is an AI Commerce agency for Shopify brands, helping companies break through growth and operational bottlenecks by modernizing systems, automating workflows, and embedding intelligence across operations, marketing, and product management.
 



 Through the right mix of technology, training, and hands\-on partnership, Lake House helps brands move with more clarity, speed, and adaptability in the era of intelligent commerce.
